name: Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, and Biochemistry (MCB) PhD Program

english.toefl: 90 before January 21, 2026; 4.5 on or after January 21, 2026
english.note: IELTS 7 is a recommended minimum. Programs may require higher scores. English-medium degrees may exempt testing; applicants outside the listed countries should arrange a Registrar/Dean letter confirming English instruction.

applicationFee.note: Documented financial hardship: request through the application with an explanation and accepted financial-aid/FAFSA/CSS/unemployment/test-fee-reduction documentation. Recommended at least two weeks before deadline. International applicants should confirm documentation eligibility.

documents: College transcripts with certified English translations where needed
Two MCB questions in place of a personal statement (250–500 words each)
One Graduate School community/inclusion question (300 words maximum)
requirements.note: At least two recommendations should be from faculty at the current or most recently attended institution. Recommenders submit online; Interfolio not accepted. Official final transcripts required before matriculation. Research experience and relevant coursework in cell/molecular biology, genomics, developmental biology and biochemistry evaluated. Advisor need not be identified before admission; suggest 2–3 potential advisors/research areas. FAQ has an old deadline; current prospective-students page explicitly gives Fall 2027.

funding.note: Central doctoral support applies to domestic and foreign students, conditional on satisfactory academic progress; transfer-student funding may vary. MCB guarantees support for all students, including stipend, tuition and health insurance.

deadlines.label: Application deadline
deadlines.note: Current central program listing; older department FAQ dates are not substituted.
